description.zh:
任务唯一标识

> 
>- taskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的taskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>- 建议手动赋值taskId，以便关联上下文。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the task.

> - Specifying taskId is optional. The system generates one automatically. Tasks with the same taskId are grouped into the same conversation.
>
> - Manually assign a taskId to associate context between tasks.
